payload.prompt:
Build a cross-chain DeFi aggregator that combines Uniswap V3 concentrated
liquidity, Aave flash loans, Compound lending, MakerDAO CDP management,
and Curve stable swaps. Include MEV protection via commit-reveal schemes,
implement Dutch auction liquidations, support 15+ different tokens with
custom pricing oracles, and add a governance token with quadratic voting,
delegation, and time-locked proposals. The contract should also handle
yield farming across multiple protocols, auto-compound rewards, and
provide insurance against smart contract risks through a decentralized
insurance pool.
